messages:
lina_s (Sales): Sierra asked for a perf POC next Tue. Requirements: sustained 400 QPS, short microbursts to 2k QPS, p95 <= 250ms, and SOC2 artifacts before sign-off. Can Eng + Solutions scope runbook and cost sketch?

raj_e (Eng): Got it. Need region (they prefer us-west-2), avg tokens (they said ~160 in / 120 out), and confirm Dedicated w/ VPC peering ok. Also, do they use streaming?

marta_solutions: Security call notes: customer-managed CMKs (HSM), VPC peering for control plane, audit logs per inference. They prefer Dedicated for the POC.

lina_s (Sales): Confirmed: Dedicated with VPC peering is fine. Streaming used in one flow.

raj_e (Eng): Proposed concise run plan:
- Warmup 5m @50 QPS
- Ramp 10m to 500 QPS
- Sustained 30m @400 QPS
- Microbursts: 3x 30s @2k QPS spaced 10m
- Cooldown 5m @50 QPS
Capture p50/p95/p99, tokens/sec, cache hit, GPU util, queue length, 429/5xx, and trace samples. Include a 5m cold-cache run.

raj_e (Eng): Non-streaming load sample (vegeta):
echo '{"model":"rw-13b-v1","input":"<sample>","max_tokens":120}' > body.json
vegeta attack -rate=400 -duration=30m -targets=<(printf "POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
@body.json") | vegeta report

raj_e (Eng): For streaming do a separate client measuring first-byte and last-byte. Vegeta won't capture chunked streaming well.

kevin_oncall: Ops notes: enable Dedicated autoscaling/burst pool. Fallback: shift 30% to rw-7b-quant if p95 >500ms for >2m. Alerting: p95>300ms notify, errors>0.5% page.

marta_solutions: Security checklist for the PO: customer CIDR, KMS ARN, SOC2 report, pentest notes window, and contract addendum for audit logs. I'll draft and loop in Legal.

lina_s (Sales): Pricing: they want a 2-week pilot estimate plus monthly at 400 QPS. Raj, can you give a quick ballpark?

raj_e (Eng): Quick calc: ~280 tokens/request -> 112k tokens/s at 400 QPS -> ~9.68B tokens/day -> ~135.5B tokens for 14 days. Recommend scaled smoke at 10% amplitude plus one full day test and extrapolate to avoid massive spend.

marta_solutions: Present two cost scenarios: Hosted per-token and Dedicated reserved commit. Call out burst overages and one-day full-run fee for validation.

deploy-bot: Dedicated pool "sierra-dedicated-1" provisioning in us-west-2 (eta ~35m).

raj_e (Eng): Action items: I'll drop vegeta + streaming scripts and a metric dashboard tomorrow EOD. Will run a 10% smoke once pool is ready and post initial numbers here.

lina_s (Sales): Perfect. I'll collect CIDR, KMS ARN, and sample payload from Sierra and confirm they accept the scaled approach.

kevin_oncall: One more: include a cold-cache run to show worst-case tail latencies. Page if p95>500ms for 2m.

lina_s (Sales): Thanks all, will update Sierra after I have the security bits.
